import sys,tempfile,subprocess,io,contextlib,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts'))
import record_versioned_signoff as r
import build_polaris_dossier_local_agent_mode_v1_3 as v13
import build_polaris_dossier_local_agent_mode_v1_1 as v11
import build_polaris_dossier_local_agent_mode_v1_2 as v12
import prepare_three_surface_poc_governedby_reference_recording as p
own=Path('/home/orca/.tmp/syzygy-mea10-9-full-review-notes-20261105')
rows=[]
def git(root,*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),'-c','user.name=Synthetic probe','-c','user.email=synthetic@invalid','-c','core.hooksPath=/dev/null',*args],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True).strip()
for name in ('design.md','proposal.md'):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='binding-probe-') as temp:
  root=Path(temp);v13._fixture(root)
  (root/r.AGGREGATE_REL).write_text('# Synthetic record; no owner act\n')
  git(root,'init','-q');git(root,'config','gc.auto','0');git(root,'config','maintenance.auto','false');git(root,'add','-A');git(root,'commit','-qm','Synthetic reviewed v1.3 fixture')
  commit=git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD');review='docs/reviews/R-SYNTHETIC-BINDING-RAW.md'
  (root/review).write_text(f'# Review polaris-dossier-local-agent-mode\nReviewed commit: {commit}\nManifest SHA-256: {v13.sha(v13.subject_bytes(root))}\nVerdict: CONFIRM\n\n## Findings\n\nNo findings.\n')
  pkg=r.real_packages()['polaris-dossier-local-agent-mode@1.3']
  assert r.verify_reviewed(root,pkg,review,None)==(commit,'CONFIRM')
  patch=root/v13.PROPOSED/(name+'.patch');before=patch.read_bytes();old=('Design v1.3.' if name=='design.md' else 'Proposal v1.3.');new=old+' Unreviewed probe edit.'
  patch.write_bytes(before.replace(old.encode(),new.encode()))
  subjects={str(rel):(root/rel).read_bytes() for rel in v13.TARGETS};aggregate=(root/r.AGGREGATE_REL).read_bytes()
  out=io.StringIO()
  with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):code=r.record(root,pkg,'1.3','2026-11-05','Synthetic selection; no owner action',review,None)
  unchanged=all((root/rel).read_bytes()==body for rel,body in subjects.items()) and aggregate==(root/r.AGGREGATE_REL).read_bytes() and not (root/v13.V13_RECORD).exists()
  rows.append({'phase':'pre-record','file':str(patch.relative_to(root)),'source_commit':commit,'old':old,'new':new,'exit_code':code,'output':out.getvalue(),'all_installed_targets_and_records_unchanged':unchanged})
  assert code==1 and 'package bytes changed since the commit the review read' in out.getvalue() and unchanged
  patch.write_bytes(before)
  out=io.StringIO()
  with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):code=r.record(root,pkg,'1.3','2026-11-05','Synthetic selection; no owner action',review,None)
  assert code==0,out.getvalue()
  clean=io.StringIO()
  with contextlib.redirect_stdout(clean):clean_code=r.check(root,pkg,'1.3')
  assert clean_code==0 and v13.signed_findings(root)==[]
  installed=root/v13.CHANGE/name
  patch.write_bytes(before.replace(old.encode(),new.encode()));installed.write_bytes(installed.read_bytes().replace(old.encode(),new.encode()))
  out=io.StringIO()
  with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):code=r.check(root,pkg,'1.3')
  frozen=v11.review_digest(root,v12.V12_RECORD)
  findings=v13.signed_findings(root);later=p.later_signed_input(root,str(v13.SPEC),frozen)
  rows.append({'phase':'post-record','file':str(patch.relative_to(root)),'installed':str(installed.relative_to(root)),'old':old,'new':new,'clean_check_exit':clean_code,'check_exit':code,'check_output':out.getvalue(),'builder_signed_findings':findings,'p115_later_signed_input':later,'spec_digest_unchanged':v13.sha((root/v13.SPEC).read_bytes())==v11.review_digest(root,v13.V13_RECORD)})
  assert code==0 and findings==[] and later
result={'synthetic_only':True,'owner_action':False,'rows':rows}
(own/sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
